title: why pakistani hating india
lines: Pakistan aur India ke beech aakhir aisi kaunsi nafrat hai jo khatam hi nahi hoti?
Bachpan se humein yahi sikhaya gaya ki woh hamare dushman hain.
Lekin kya sach mein ek aam Pakistani aapko dekhte hi goli maar dega?
Asli kahani wahan ke netaon aur media ki hai, jo apni kursi bachane ke liye roz India ke khilaf zehar ugalte hain.
Wahan ki history books mein India ko villain ki tarah dikhaya jata hai taaki logon ka dhyan asli muddon se hat sake.
Lekin jab wahi Pakistani Dubai ya Canada mein milte hain, toh woh gale milte hain aur chai peete hain!
Nafrat logon ke dilon mein nahi, balki system ke dimaag mein ghusai gayi hai.
Aapko kya lagta hai, yeh dushmani kabhi khatam hogi ya nahi?

script:
Pakistan aur India ke beech aakhir aisi kaunsi nafrat hai jo khatam hi nahi hoti? 
Bachpan se humein yahi sikhaya gaya ki woh hamare dushman hain. 
Lekin kya sach mein ek aam Pakistani aapko dekhte hi goli maar dega? 
Bilkul nahi! 
Asli kahani wahan ke netaon aur media ki hai, jo apni kursi bachane ke liye roz India ke khilaf zehar ugalte hain. 
Wahan ki history books mein India ko villain ki tarah dikhaya jata hai taaki logon ka dhyan asli muddon se hat sake. 
Lekin jab wahi Pakistani Dubai ya Canada mein milte hain, toh woh gale milte hain aur chai peete hain! 
Nafrat logon ke dilon mein nahi, balki system ke dimaag mein ghusai gayi hai. 
Aapko kya lagta hai, yeh dushmani kabhi khatam hogi ya nahi?
